description: This Swift source file defines a `NotifyOverlayController` class responsible for managing lightweight, borderless in-app toast notifications on macOS. It includes methods for presenting and dismissing notifications, handling window creation, layout, and animations. The code also defines a SwiftUI view `NotifyOverlayView` used as the notification content.

classes.name: NotifyOverlayController
classes.description: A singleton controller managing presentation and dismissal of overlay notifications

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays a notification with specified title and body, optionally auto-dismissing after a given time

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Initializes the overlay window if it doesn't exist

methods.name: presentWindow
methods.description: Handles the presentation logic of the overlay window

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the frame (position and size) for the notification window

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window's frame, optionally with animation

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height needed for the notification based on title and body content
